issues.issue: This line is almost evenly split, with Street slightly dominant (51%). Under the dominant-fund rule it would be streets/highways.

This is General Fund money in an object-only statement, so the fund-function rule gives general government, and the detail line for the same amount uses general government. The statement line is in other. The printed label says Miscellaneous, so other is defensible, but the two are inconsistent.

issues.on_page: Grants, Bonds & Loans 82,189.00 (Water Fund nonoperating); shown under Grants & Donations on the Statement of Activities (p5)
issues.issue: The label mixes grants with bond/loan proceeds. A water-project grant would more likely be intergovernmental/state aid or federal grants than a private donation, and loan or bond proceeds would be business_type.debt_proceeds.

issues.on_page: Grants, Bonds & Loans 82,189.00 (30% of business-type receipts)
issues.issue: decision_needed is missing the question whether this amount is a grant (receipt) or bond/loan proceeds (debt_proceeds). The label leaves it open.
